output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Good evening Marek, good evening all,

Thank you for posting the lineup. I would like to raise a few points about Liliana, who is my student. I was not consulted before the list was published. On 1 October you wrote that coaches of the players would be consulted before the final lineup, so I am doing it now, while there is still time before the Friday deadline.

The lineup follows the November rating list alone. The criteria announced in the same message were the rating list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier on 24 October. In that qualifier Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, ahead of Maja, Igor and Antoni. She beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Igor scored 4/7.

Her rating also needs some context. The -81 comes only from the Katowice open in early October, which she played while not in good health. Before that she was rated about 1932. For health reasons she also missed around two weeks of training in October. She is now back to her normal level, and her last three lessons were very good. I do not think 1851 reflects her current strength.

I want to be clear that I have nothing against Igor. He is a good boy and, as Rafael said, he has had a steady autumn. My concern is only that the criteria are applied as they were announced.

My proposal is that Liliana plays on board 2. If you would rather have a clear sporting answer, a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday would also be fine with me, and I would accept the result.

Thank you for considering this.

Best regards,
Oksana
